prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: Catalan CACE school vocabulary stimulus, level N2, entity plus attribute. ONE clear school-friendly flat 2D educational drawing with simple solid colors, clean outlines, readable realistic proportions. No 3D rendering. Target construction in Catalan: Pilota en forma de quadrat. Exact CACE concepts: PILOTA + QUADRAT. Make the named entity immediately recognizable and the single target attribute visually explicit. The whole object has a clearly SQUARE silhouette with four equal straight sides and right angles. For a ball or fruit this is intentionally fantastical but the original entity remains recognizable. Depict ONLY the target entity and necessary attribute evidence. No people, no unrelated objects. The only allowed secondary objects are the specified size reference or contents inside the target container. Pure white seamless background, only necessary context, generous uninterrupted white margins on every side, ZOOM OUT: the subject must occupy ONLY the central 65 percent of the frame; leave at least a broad 12 percent pure-white blank border on ALL sides, including above ears and below feet. Do not fill the canvas. Entire subject fully inside image, complete ears, limbs, feet and object edges. Keep all objects inside the frame. Natural correct anatomy, no extra limbs. No text, letters, numerals, labels, signs, logos, brands, watermark, speech bubbles or pseudowriting anywhere. No border, no collage. The vocabulary words will be shown outside the image in the app. For an imaginary creature, keep it friendly and suitable for primary-school material; no horror, blood or violence.
